title: The Xiao Gate in Feng City
summary: The Crazy Lion Sect, Dark Sky Sect and Luo Sha Gate decide to take Feng City from Xiao Li's new Xiao Gate. Xiao Yan masters the first God Seal, the Open Mountain Seal, and drags Medusa along to the city. He arrives as the three leaders threaten Xiao Li, and Medusa's Dou Zong power scares them off. Instead of punishing them, Xiao Yan offers a deal: help him fight the Misty Cloud Sect for 30% of Feng City's rule and a Mighty Huang Pill. Medusa refuses to help fight Yun Shan, and Xiao Li agrees to find the last two herbs for a pill. With the treasures from Han Feng's ring, Xiao Yan gets the herbs for the Spiritual Recovery Purple Pill and refines one for Hai Bodong in a cauldron that hides the pill's signs, while Xiao Li plans a pill auction in Feng City.

cultivation: The Mighty Huang Pill raises a Dou Huang by one or two stars at once. Xiao Yan says he is a sixth-tier alchemist. The Misty Cloud Sect has one Dou Huang besides Yun Shan, a Dou Zong.
